Product Description:

Our Portable Massage Foot Bath Spa is the ultimate tool for soothing and rejuvenating tired feet. Compact, lightweight, and user-friendly, this device combines gentle massage, heat therapy, and bubble functions to provide a luxurious spa experience. Its ergonomic design ensures comfort and relaxation, whether at home or in a professional salon setting.

Key Features:

  • Adjustable heat settings for tailored comfort
  • Bubble function for a relaxing spa-like experience
  • Compact and foldable design for easy storage and portability
  • Sturdy build for long-term durability
  • Non-slip base for safety during use

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Affordable Luxury: Delivering high-end features at a budget-friendly price.
  • Portable Convenience: Foldable design makes it easy to carry and store, perfect for small spaces.
  • Customizable Experience: Multiple heat and massage settings allow you to personalize your relaxation.
  • Health Benefits: Promotes better circulation, reduces stress, and relieves foot fatigue.

Payment Terms:

  • Flexible payment options include major credit/debit cards, PayPal, and buy-now-pay-later services (e.g., Klarna, Afterpay).
  • Payment required in full at the time of purchase.
  • Bulk purchase discounts available for salons or resellers.

Other Information:

  • Warranty: Includes a 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects.
  • Customer Support: 24/7 customer service available to assist with setup, usage, or troubleshooting.
  • Shipping: Free standard shipping within the continental U.S.; expedited options available at additional cost.
  • Returns: 30-day satisfaction guarantee with hassle-free returns.
